name: ru-math-benchmark
description: A Russian-language mathematics problem dataset evaluating models on solving school/university-style math problems in Russian. It contains problems requiring symbolic reasoning, arithmetic/algebraic manipulation, and short-form numeric or textual answers. Evaluation measures models' ability to produce correct solutions in the target language and numeric form.
reputation: A community-contributed Russian math dataset on Hugging Face with limited but growing use in Russian-language math-ML evaluations.
